items.title: fix(anthropic): detect Claude CLI routes pinned to non-default models…
items.summary: fix(anthropic): detect Claude CLI routes pinned to non-default models (#113424) * fix(anthropic): detect Claude CLI routes pinned to non-default models Route detection probed one hardcoded model id, so moving the packaged CLI default stopped advertising session creation for configs routing an older Claude model, and adoption stamped the packaged default onto sessions the operator never routed. Probe the seeded CLI model ids instead and reuse the routed model for both paths. Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 * fix(anthropic): keep the canonical CLI model id module-local The route probe replaced its only external consumer, so the export is dead. Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 --------- Co-authored-by: Claude Fable 5
